tips.text: Cast Crescent Strike first, then dash with Lunar Rush onto the marked target. The dash cooldown resets, so you can chain onto another target.
Don't worry about missing Crescent Strike. Its cooldown is short and it costs little mana, so throw it out often.
Use Pale Cascade when you start a fight or a camp. The shield absorbs damage, and the orbiting spheres hit enemies who touch them.
Use Moonfall in a team fight when several enemies are close. It pulls them in and leaves them slowed, and it hits harder for each extra champion pulled.
Cast abilities between basic attacks. Each cast speeds up your attacks, and Moonsilver Blade's third attack cleaves everything near the target.
Think before using Lunar Rush on a target with no Moonlight. It goes on a long cooldown and can leave you stuck in the middle of the enemy team.

combos.name: Engage with Moonfall after E
combos.when: When you are diving into a group of enemies and want to pull them in.
combos.text: Q and E close the gap and reset the dash. Moonfall then pulls the team in, and Pale Cascade adds its shield and burst.

tips.text: Aim Crescent Strike at where the enemy is walking, not where they stand. It is a curved arc, and the cooldown is short, so a miss costs little.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush. The dash comes back off cooldown at once, so you can dash again to a minion or the enemy.
Don't use Lunar Rush on an enemy who isn't marked unless you have to. Without the reset you are stuck up close with a long wait before you can dash out.
Cast Pale Cascade just before you trade. The orbiting spheres hit anyone who gets close, and the shield soaks up damage while you fight.
Cast an ability before you start attacking. Moonsilver Blade gives bonus Attack Speed after a spell, and every third hit cleaves for extra damage.
At level 6, use Moonfall when the enemy team is grouped. It pulls them in and leaves them slowed, and it hits harder for each extra champion pulled.
Use Moonfall and Lunar Rush to stay on a target who is running away, so your attacks keep triggering Moonsilver Blade.

combos.name: Moonfall into Q and E
combos.when: When you want to catch targets who are out of range, or pull several enemies together in a fight.
combos.text: Moonfall pulls enemies in and slows them. Follow with Q to mark them, then E to dash on and reset it for chasing.

tips.text: Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush and use it again to chain onto Graves.
Do not dash into Smoke Screen; you will be slowed and can't see out of it.
Open the fight with Pale Cascade so the shield covers you while Graves shoots.
Fight Graves up close. Use Moonfall at level 6 to pull him in, so he can't get away.
Graves loses his armor bonus once Quickdraw stacks run out, so burst him after he has used it.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Dragon Strike along that line knocks you up.
Land Crescent Strike first, then Lunar Rush onto the marked target. The cooldown refreshes, so you can dash again to escape or follow up.
Use Moonfall when Jarvan commits, to pull him in and slow him. A slowed Jarvan has a harder time making the most of Cataclysm.
Cast Pale Cascade before you go in on Jarvan. The shield absorbs his damage, and the orbs hit him as you trade.
Aim Crescent Strike at Kayn first, then dash in with Lunar Rush; hitting him with Moonlight lets you use Lunar Rush again right away.
Save Moonfall for when Kayn jumps on you or when you want to fight him; it pulls him in and leaves him slowed.
Cast Pale Cascade when Kayn closes in; the shield soaks his burst and the orbs hit him if he stays close.
Moonlight reveals Kayn, so use Crescent Strike to find him when he hides in a wall during Shadow Step.
Stay close to your minions and allies. Kha'Zix does much less damage with Taste Their Fear when you are not isolated.
Hit Kha'Zix with Crescent Strike to reveal him. Then use Lunar Rush to jump onto him and reset its cooldown.
Fight Kha'Zix right after he uses Leap. He is easier to punish while it is on cooldown.
Use Pale Cascade when Kha'Zix jumps in. The shield absorbs his burst and the orbs hit him as he closes.
Land Crescent Strike on Kindred first, then dash in with Lunar Rush; the Moonlight mark refreshes the dash so you can stay on her.
Kindred is fragile. Go after her with Moonfall when she is away from her team, so she is pulled in and slowed.
Wait out Lamb's Respite before you finish a fight. Nobody inside it can die, and everyone is healed when it ends.
Open a fight with Pale Cascade so its shield soaks her damage while the orbs hit her.
Kindred slows you with Mounting Dread and then pounces on her third attack. Do not stay in a long trade with her.
Hit Crescent Strike first, then use Lunar Rush on a marked Lee Sin. The dash comes back almost at once, so you can stick to him.
Use Pale Cascade when Lee Sin jumps in. The shield absorbs his burst and the orbs hit him as he stays on you.
Lee Sin needs his Sonic Wave to connect to chase you. Sidestep it, and he loses his best way to close in.
Moonfall pulls Lee Sin back in and slows him. Use it when he tries to escape, or to finish a fight.
Pull Master Yi in with Moonfall when he is slowed or about to run. Highlander stops the slow but not the pull.
Hold Lunar Rush until Master Yi has used Alpha Strike. While he's untargetable you can't catch him, and you'd be exposed.
Hit Master Yi with Crescent Strike first, then Lunar Rush onto him to get the cooldown back and keep chasing.
Burst Master Yi while Meditate is down. While he channels it, he takes much less damage and heals.
Open fights with Pale Cascade. Its shield soaks his attacks and its orbs hit him when he jumps onto you.
Land Crescent Strike on Naafiri, then follow with Lunar Rush; the Moonlight mark refreshes Lunar Rush so you can chain onto her again.
Cast Moonfall when Naafiri and her packmates jump on you; it pulls them in and leaves them slowed.
Open Pale Cascade before she dives in; the orbs hit her and her packmates, and the shield soaks her burst.
Wait for Naafiri to use up The Call of the Pack before you commit; while she is untargetable, your spells can't hit her.
Do not rely on Lunar Rush to escape Nocturne's Paranoia; his dash cannot be stopped by crowd control.
Bait Shroud of Darkness with Crescent Strike before committing Lunar Rush or Moonfall.
Use Lunar Rush to get out of Unspeakable Horror's range so the tether breaks before the fear.
Open Pale Cascade when Nocturne dives in; the shield soaks his burst.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush; the mark makes Lunar Rush ready again so you can dash back out.
Don't use Moonfall to start a fight if Shyvana has her ultimate ready; she flies out of it and punishes you.
Pale Cascade first when Shyvana is close; the shield absorbs her trade and the orbs hurt her.
Keep your distance from Shyvana and poke with Crescent Strike while her Dragon Fury is low.
Do not run at Skarner without a plan. Ixtal's Impact can carry you into a wall and stun you.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush. The dash refreshes when the target has Moonlight, so you can retreat or keep going.
Stay out of Impale's reach when Skarner is close. Use Lunar Rush to get away before he lashes forward.
Moonfall pulls in and slows Skarner and his allies. Use it to hold a fight together once you are on top of them.
Land Crescent Strike on Sylas, then use Lunar Rush on him. The dash refreshes, so you can stay on him.
Hold Moonfall until Sylas has used Abduct or Kingslayer. Pulling him in when he has no escape sets up your kill.
Trade with Pale Cascade up. The shield soaks his burst, and the orbs hit him if he steps in to fight.
Finish Sylas before he gets low and heals. Kingslayer heals him more the lower his health is.
Hold Moonfall when Sylas is near enough to steal it. Fight him when his Hijack is on cooldown.
Cast Crescent Strike first, then Lunar Rush onto the marked Talon; the dash comes back at once so you can stay on him.
Open with Pale Cascade before Talon dives; the shield and orbs blunt his burst.
Use Moonfall when Talon jumps in to pull him back and slow him. It stops him leaving and gives you time to finish.
Watch for Talon going invisible with Shadow Assault; Moonlight from Crescent Strike reveals only enemies that are not stealthed.
Cast Crescent Strike first, then dash with Lunar Rush on the marked target. The cooldown refreshes and you can chain straight into a fight.
Use Moonfall when Viego dives in. It pulls him to you and leaves him slowed, so he can't easily slip away.
Open Pale Cascade before trading. The shield soaks his hits while the orbs hit him if he stays close.
Moonlight reveals Viego when he hides in the mist of Harrowed Path. Land Crescent Strike on him to see him again.
Don't fight near a fresh kill. If someone dies, Viego can take their body and use their abilities.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush; the Moonlight mark refreshes its cooldown so you can chain onto Xin Zhao.
Cast Pale Cascade as Xin Zhao charges in; the shield and orbs soften his Three Talon Strike combo.
Do not stand in a line from Xin Zhao: Wind Becomes Lightning slows you and marks you for his Audacious Charge. Sidestep the thrust.
Dodge Charm by walking behind minions; if it lands you're stunned, so keep your dash for after it, not before.
Land Crescent Strike first, then Lunar Rush onto the marked Ahri; the dash cooldown resets so you can chase again.
Open a trade with Pale Cascade active so its shield absorbs Orb of Deception and Fox-Fire.
Go for Ahri when Spirit Rush is on cooldown; she has far fewer ways to escape you.
Use Moonfall to pull Ahri in and slow her when she tries to dash away.
Open with Crescent Strike, then follow with Lunar Rush on the marked Akali; the cooldown refreshes so you can chase again.
Crescent Strike also reveals Akali, so use it to find her when she hides in Twilight Shroud.
Do not use Lunar Rush with no Moonlight on Akali; her Five Point Strike will slow you and punish you.
Use Moonfall when Akali jumps in, to pull her back and slow her.
Fight Akali when her energy is low, and cast Pale Cascade before she engages so the shield is up.
Dodge Flash Frost by moving sideways; it is wide but slow to arrive, and the stun comes at the end.
Hit Crescent Strike on Anivia, then use Lunar Rush to jump in and reset it.
Wait for Anivia to use Crystallize, then dash in around the gap.
Use Moonfall to pull Anivia out of position and burst her.
Do not stand in Glacial Storm; it slows you more as it grows.
After Anivia returns as an egg, kill it before she is reborn.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush. Hitting a marked enemy refreshes its cooldown, so you can dash again right away.
Aurora's Across the Veil makes her invisible, but Crescent Strike's Moonlight reveals enemies. Hit her with it to keep her in sight.
Use Pale Cascade when you walk into her range; the shield soaks her The Weirding and Twofold Hex while the orbs hit her.
Moonfall pulls Aurora in even as she tries to hop away. Save it for after she uses Across the Veil or The Weirding.
Stay out of the rift from Between Worlds when you can. Walking through its edge slows you, and she can hop across it freely.
Land Crescent Strike, then dash in with Lunar Rush. It refreshes when the target has Moonlight, so you can keep chasing Cassiopeia.
Don't dash in with Lunar Rush if Miasma is ready. You will be grounded and slowed with nowhere to go.
Don't walk straight at Cassiopeia at level 6. Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you face her, but only slows you if you turn away.
Use Moonfall to pull Cassiopeia in close, where her range advantage is gone and she can't easily kite.
Cast Pale Cascade before you walk into Noxious Blast range. The shield and orbs soften her poke.
Land Crescent Strike first, then Lunar Rush onto Fizz; the Moonlight mark resets Lunar Rush so you can chase again.
Don't Lunar Rush at Fizz while he can hop; Playful makes him untargetable and your dash is wasted.
Wait until Fizz uses Playful, then use Moonfall as he lands; it pulls him in, slows him and leaves him nowhere to go.
Cast Pale Cascade when Fizz dives in; the orbs hit him as he closes and the shield softens his burst.
Stay away from the lure of Chum the Waters when you see it flying; step out before the shark lands.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush; the marked target lets you use Lunar Rush again right away.
Malzahar is hard to hurt while Void Shift is up. Hit him with Pale Cascade or Crescent Strike from range to break it before you commit.
Do not walk into Call of the Void; being silenced leaves you unable to cast your spells. Sidestep it before diving.
Avoid minions with Malefic Visions on them; when they die it spreads to you.
Do not dive when Nether Grasp is ready; you cannot act while suppressed. Fight when it is on cooldown.
Dodge Orianna's Command: Attack, and walk in when it is on cooldown. Her Ball only affects the area it is in.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash with Lunar Rush. Hitting Moonlight makes Lunar Rush ready again, so you can stay on her.
Open the fight with Pale Cascade as you reach Orianna. The shield protects you and the orbs hit her when you get close.
Watch where the Ball is. Orianna's Command: Shockwave only reaches what is near it, so stay out of that area until she wastes the Ball.
Do not walk through Command: Dissonance's field. It slows you, which makes it easy for Orianna to hit you.
Use Moonfall to pull Orianna in and slow her when you are close. Bring teammates if you can, since extra champions pulled add damage.
Land Crescent Strike on Ryze, then dash in with Lunar Rush; the reset lets you stay on him.
Avoid walking up when Ryze has Spell Flux on you; Rune Prison will root you instead of slowing.
Use Pale Cascade when Ryze starts poking you; the shield soaks his damage and the orbs hit him if he stays close.
Use Moonfall to pull Ryze in when he is out of position; he has no easy way to escape the follow-up damage.
Stay out of the line of Overload when it is ready, and fight when his spells are on cooldown.
Land Crescent Strike first, then dash in with Lunar Rush; hitting a marked target refreshes Lunar Rush so you can chain onto him again.
Fight Sylas when he is low on health only if you can finish him fast; Kingslayer heals him more the lower he is.
Cast Pale Cascade before he reaches you to absorb his burst; its shield soaks his Abduct and Chain Lash damage.
Use Moonfall when Sylas dashes onto you; it pulls him in and leaves him slowed so you can finish him.
Step out of the line of Abduct; if its chains hit you, you are stunned and knocked up.
Hit Crescent Strike on Twisted Fate, then dash in with Lunar Rush. If the dash resets, you can chase him down.
Do not dash in with Lunar Rush when Twisted Fate has his Gold Card ready. You will be stunned with no way out.
Use Pale Cascade before you walk into Wild Cards range so the shield absorbs his damage.
Use Moonfall to pull Twisted Fate in so he cannot get away from you.
Move out of the way when you see Twisted Fate use Destiny. He may be about to teleport in on you.
Land Crescent Strike on Viktor, then use Lunar Rush to jump on him. Lunar Rush comes back for another dash if he was hit.
Do not dash into Viktor's Gravity Field. Wait for it to end or leave it quickly, or you get stunned.
Use Moonfall to pull Viktor to you when he tries to keep his distance; it also slows him.
Sidestep Hextech Ray rather than walking in a straight line; it hits everything along its path.
Cast Pale Cascade before you go in so its shield absorbs his poke.
Hold Crescent Strike until Yasuo walks up to last-hit; it is a bolt, so he can dodge it by stepping aside, but his Wind Wall will block it.
Bait Wind Wall first, then throw Crescent Strike once it is down and the wall's long cooldown is running.
Hit Crescent Strike, then dash in with Lunar Rush to reset it and keep the fight going.
Use Pale Cascade when Yasuo wants to trade; the shield and orbs punish him for walking into you.
Yasuo's whirlwind knocks you up, so stay out of its path when he has two stacks of Steel Tempest.
Moonfall pulls in and slows Yasuo; use it to start a kill at level 6, when his dashes are tougher to escape.
Land Crescent Strike first, then use Lunar Rush on the marked Yone; the dash refreshes and you can jump out again.
Cast Pale Cascade when Yone walks up to trade; the orbs hit him as he closes in and the shield soaks his damage.
Pull Yone in with Moonfall at level 6 when he is out of position; he is slowed and can't walk away from the follow-up.
Keep your distance when Yone has two stacks of Mortal Steel; the wind dash knocks you up.
Don't spend Lunar Rush on an unmarked Yone; he can punish you stuck next to him when you have no way back out.
Land Crescent Strike on Zed, then dash in with Lunar Rush. It refreshes when he has Moonlight, so you can chain it for extra damage.
Cast Pale Cascade when Zed dives at you. The shield and the orbs punish his short trades.
Use Moonfall when Zed commits to you. He ends up slowed and pulled in beside you, so he can't escape easily.
Keep Crescent Strike ready when Zed uses Death Mark on you. Its short cooldown and long range make it easy to poke him from far away.
